environment.description: Rails 7.1 application deployed on EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) in a public subnet with internet gateway. Application runs as ec2-user with read/write access to the filesystem. The instance has an attached IAM role with S3 and SQS permissions. Security group allows inbound on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application serves as a document ingestion API for a multi-tenant SaaS platform.
